# Roles × permissions matrix

Default system roles. System roles are read-only; create custom roles in **Settings → RBAC** (requires `role:manage`).

| Permission | Description | Super Admin | Admin | Security Analyst | Approver | Viewer | Auditor |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| `cve:view` | View CVEs, CVE details, source health and saved searches | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `cve:refresh` | Trigger a manual 'Refresh now' of CVE sources | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — |
| `advisory:create` | Create and edit advisory email drafts | ✅ | — | ✅ | — | — | — |
| `advisory:approve` | Approve advisories and templates (cannot approve own work) | ✅ | — | — | ✅ | — | — |
| `advisory:send` | Send approved advisories via SMTP | ✅ | — | ✅ | — | — | — |
| `advisory:export` | Download .eml / HTML / PDF / Excel exports | ✅ | — | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
| `template:manage` | Create and version advisory templates | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | — |
| `news:view` | View the Security News feed | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `news:manage` | Add or remove news feeds | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | — |
| `source:manage` | Enable/disable CVE sources and change fetch intervals | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | — |
| `integration:manage` | Configure security-tool connectors and credentials | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | — |
| `settings:manage` | Manage database, SMTP and alert settings | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | — |
| `sso:manage` | Configure Okta SAML / OIDC and SailPoint mappings | ✅ | — | — | — | — | — |
| `user:manage` | Create users, assign roles, unlock accounts | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | — |
| `role:manage` | Create and edit custom roles | ✅ | — | — | — | — | — |
| `ai:use` | Use AI summaries, drafting and assistant | ✅ | — | ✅ | ✅ | — | — |
| `ai:manage` | Configure AI providers, allowlist and redaction policy | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | — |
| `audit:view` | View the immutable audit log | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — | ✅ |
| `intel:manage` | Add manual intel items, import intel bundles and view TLP:RED subscription intel | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | — |

## Role descriptions

- **Super Admin** — Full control, including roles and SSO. Break-glass only.
- **Admin** — Operates the platform: sources, integrations, settings, users. No advisory approval or send.
- **Security Analyst** — Triages CVEs and prepares, exports and sends approved advisories.
- **Approver** — Reviews and approves advisories and templates.
- **Viewer** — Read-only access to CVEs and news.
- **Auditor** — Read-only plus the audit log.
